title: Fraud, please don't subscribe to this app
body: It changed the premium plan from "life time access" to "monthly subscription" without any notification. Even I paid for "life time access" it requires me to pay again. This app didn't clarify or send any information to me before change of plan.
author: 暱稱重用又重用

title: Good App but Abrupt Change in Pricing Strategy
body: The app is easy to use, intuitive with useful features that allows you to see statistics of your habit and goals. HOWEVER, before it changed its pricing plan in late Jan, it offered 3 payment options for users to pay and have life time access. I chose the cheapest option to pay for “life time time access”, and the app just suddenly changed to charging an annual subscription fee within a month. This is inconceivable and misleading for consumers. No matter how fantastic your app is and how many people downloaded your app, you can’t just promise your users life time access and suddenly change it. I already emailed the app’s support team last week and there has been no reply since. This is infuriating. For those of you considering whether or not you want to subscribe for premium, think carefully!!!
